errors.request: That request could not be completed.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

page.title: AI lead scoring
page.description: Controls whether workspaces can score their contacts with an AI model, which model does it, the limits, and what it costs.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can see or change AI lead scoring.

switch.title: Platform switch
switch.hintOn: Workspaces that opted in can score their contacts.
switch.hintOff: No workspace can score contacts, whatever its own setting says.

model.title: Model
model.custom: A model typed in by hand, not on the list.

key.title: Platform OpenRouter key
key.explainReady: Workspaces without their own OpenRouter key are scored with this one, and you pay for those scores.
key.explainMissing: Without a platform key, only workspaces that saved their own OpenRouter key can score contacts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Changes apply to every workspace at once. Only the fields you change are saved.

enabled.label: AI lead scoring
enabled.hint: Off by default. When on, workspaces that opted in send anonymised contact facts to OpenRouter to get a score from 0 to 100. Turn it off to stop all scoring.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Prices are US dollars per million tokens, from OpenRouter's list.
model.details: {input} per million input tokens, {output} per million output tokens.
model.customHint: Any model id from OpenRouter that supports structured output.

limits.title: Limits
limits.scoresPerHourHint: A cost guard for workspaces that use the platform key. 0 means no limit.
limits.retentionDaysHint: Older runs, and their cost history, are deleted. 7 to 730 days.

settings.changed: {count, plural, one {# change ready to save} other {# changes ready to save}}

errors.modelId: Use an OpenRouter model id such as openai/gpt-6-luna.

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.turnOn: This lets workspaces that opted in send anonymised contact facts to OpenRouter and spend your platform key's credit.
confirm.turnOff: This stops all AI lead scoring for every workspace. Scores already saved stay.

cost.title: What scoring costs
cost.description: Totals from the scoring log, in US dollars.
cost.footnote: Costs are the amount OpenRouter reported, or an estimate from token counts when it reported none. Runs billed to a workspace's own key are part of the total but not of the platform's share.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Who uses AI lead scoring and what it cost them over the last 30 days, highest first.
workspaces.emptyMessage: Workspaces appear here once they exist.

runs.title: Scoring log
runs.description: Every scoring attempt across workspaces, newest first, with tokens, cost and who paid.

costSourceHelp.vendor: The cost OpenRouter reported for this call.
costSourceHelp.estimate: No cost was reported, so this is the token count times the model's list price.
costSourceHelp.none: No call was made, so nothing was charged.

reason.bad_response: Answer was not a valid score

runs.noMatchMessage: No scoring run matches these filters.
runs.emptyMessage: Runs appear here once a workspace scores a contact.
runs.costLegend: A ~ before a cost marks an estimate from token counts instead of the amount OpenRouter reported.
